tools.name: repair_json
tools.description: Repairs malformed LLM JSON: strips Markdown fences and prose wrappers, fixes trailing commas, converts Python literals (True/False/None) and single/unquoted keys, removes comments, recovers balanced JSON from truncated output. Body {input} -> {ok, repaired, applied}. Costs $0.001 USDC on Base per ca

tools.name: yaml_to_json
tools.description: Converts a YAML subset (block maps, sequences, nested indentation, scalars, comments) into JSON with no runtime dependency. Body {input} -> {ok, value, warnings}. Costs $0.001 USDC on Base per call.

tools.name: cron_next_run
tools.description: Computes the next UTC fire time for a 5-field cron expression (supports steps, ranges, lists, and month/weekday names). Body {expr, after?} -> {ok, next, epochMs}. Costs $0.001 USDC on Base per call.

tools.name: text_diff
tools.description: Produces a unified diff plus added/removed counts between two texts (LCS line diff, configurable context lines). Body {old, new, context?} -> {ok, identical, added, removed, hunks, unified}. Costs $0.001 USDC on Base per call.

tools.name: text_extract
tools.description: Extracts clean text, title, headings, links, URLs, and emails from HTML or plain text. Body {input, numbers?, codeBlocks?} -> {ok, source, title, headings, links, urls, emails, text}. Costs $0.001 USDC on Base per call.

tools.name: domain_whois
tools.description: Structured WHOIS via RDAP for any domain: registrar, IANA id, statuses, expiry/registration dates, nameservers, DNSSEC. Body {domain} -> {ok, found, domain, registrar, status[], events{}, nameservers[], dnssec}. Costs $0.001 USDC on Base per call.

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: JSON DNS-over-HTTPS lookup for A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, PTR, SRV, CAA. Body {domain, type?} -> {ok, domain, type, status, answers[]}. Costs $0.001 USDC on Base per call.

tools.name: github_repo_stats
tools.description: Popularity and metadata for any public GitHub repo: stars, forks, open issues, watchers, language, license, topics, last push. Body {repo} -> {ok, found, stars, forks, openIssues, language, license, pushedAt}. Costs $0.001 USDC on Base per call.

tools.name: email_validate
tools.description: Email deliverability check: RFC-style syntax plus live MX probe of the domain. Body {email} -> {ok, valid, formatValid, domainHasMx, mx[]}. Costs $0.001 USDC on Base per call.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: github_repo_stats, email_validate · Public sink: email_validate · Destructive: cron_next_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: github_repo_stats, email_validate · Public sink: email_validate · Destructive: cron_next_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
